It’s easy to play:

1) Roll the dice by shaking your smartphone or tablet
2) Open the dice cup by swiping your finger across the screen. Then look at the number you rolled but do not show the other players.
3) Close the cup and hand your smartphone to the next player. Tell him/her which number you rolled – here you can either lie or tell the truth. 
4) The next player now has two options: 
- Either they believe you, in which case they do not open the cup but roll the dice again – now they have to roll a higher number than yours and hand it to the next player (remember – they can also lie about the number they rolled)
- Or they do not believe you, in which case they open the cup to see whether you were telling the truth.
If you’re caught lying, you’re deducted a point. If you were telling the truth, the other player loses a point.

The Pony Creator is one of the most advanced character creators of its kind. Features include:

- Fully customizable height, weight, and buffness for the pony's body.
- Over 70 completely original manes and tails.
- 50+ tattoos to give your pony some personality.
- An easy to use interface that lets you preview all options in the game.
- Full 16-bit color--over 16.7 million color choices!
- Over 100 unique accessories including hats, neckties, jewelry, and more!
- Advanced posing options. Turn your pony's head and flip the body to make it look wherever you want it to.

The Pony Creator app is also compatible with the online game. If you've played the online game, import your ponies into the app using your ponycodes*.

* Due to differences in content between the app and the online game, the app may not be able to completely recreate your pony. However, it will recreate as much as possible and inform you of any problems.

Establish an ant colony! This survival and open world game will set you into a realistic simulation of the insect world. Discover a huge and detailed map populated by different kinds of other insects and watch the swarm behaviour of a complex ant colony with different castes (worker, scouts, soldiers, males, queens and larvae).

Build a deep underground ant nest by digging new chambers and tunnels! Create chambers with a different kind of purpose (food storage, larvae-, pupae chamber or queen chamber). Once your colony has enough worker ants you can accelerate the digging phase.

Search for food resources in order to feed the ant queen and the larvae to let them pupate and transform into a new ant. Once you found a food source you can create pheromone trails to attract other ants or just command them directly to follow you. 
But beware of large spiders, praying mantises, scorpions or an enemy ant colony that are ill-disposed to your colony. 
Enforce attacks to overwhelm larger insects with the power of the swarm!

Four Discs (Four in a Row) is a fun and challenging game for kids, adults, beginners and experts where the goal is to connect four discs of your own color in a row, either horizontally, vertically or diagonally before your opponent does. Play against the computer or have a game with another friend on the same device.

There are four levels of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert. The Easy level is great for kids but the Expert level is hard for gamers to beat. If you make a mistake or want to change your strategy, Four Discs lets you undo any of your moves.

Compare your score with your friends or the rest of the world with built-in Game Center leaderboards.

MAIN FEATURES

• Select between four levels of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert
• Game that is suitable for everyone from kids to adults
• Play against the computer or with another friend on the same device
• Lets you undo any of your moves if you make a mistake
• Compare your scores with your friends or the world with Game Center
• Turn sound effects On or Off
• Universal App, full native support for iPad, iPhone and iPod touch
